recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not change BodyStructure.patient back to 1..1 under FHIR-5716; any future optionality discussion belongs with the already-audited FHIR-54450/R6 BodyStructure work.
issue_request: FHIR-5716 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for DSTU1 BodySite. It asked to know who or what the body site is part of, with resolution to add BodySite.patient as 1..1 Reference(Patient).
initial_application: Commit 30f165af9ed7458068df3a2b54b7b6b474f9772d pre-applied #5716/#5731/#5852 by adding a BodySite.patient row with cardinality 1..1 and type Reference(Patient) to the BodySite spreadsheet and adding a patient reference to the BodySite example. Commit 386071a8e535114ff8df5ae7611b966cf354b3cb later renamed BodySite to BodyStructure.
additional_context: The current build lists BodyStructure as an active resource and BodySite as a removed resource. BodyStructure.patient still targets Patient, but its min is 0 after the later Applied/Persuasive R6 issue FHIR-54450 deliberately relaxed the cardinality from 1..1 to 0..1. The combined branch already contains a separate FHIR-54450 audit commit, so that issue was not duplicated here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit for FHIR-5716. Reverting BodyStructure.patient to 1..1 would conflict with later applied work, while the Patient association itself remains present in build-scope source.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 issue that intentionally relaxed BodyStructure.patient from 1..1 to 0..1 while preserving the Patient association.
Earlier Resolved - No Change request to make BodySite.patient optional; it shows OO originally kept 1..1 before FHIR-54450 later changed the rule.
BodySite was renamed to BodyStructure, explaining why current build-scope source uses the successor resource name.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request to add BodySite.patient as 1..1 Reference(Patient).
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the original DSTU1 requirement for a Patient association on BodySite.

evidence_items.summary: The pre-apply commit for #5716/#5731/#5852 added BodySite.patient 1..1 Reference(Patient) and an example patient reference.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-5716 was historically implemented in BodySite source before later resource evolution.

evidence_items.summary: BodyStructure is active, BodySite is listed as removed, and BodyStructure.patient is a Reference to Patient with max 1.
evidence_items.learned: The current build-scope successor resource preserves the Patient association requested by FHIR-5716.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive R6 issue relaxing BodyStructure.patient from 1..1 to 0..1 for non-patient-specific anatomical structure use cases.
evidence_items.learned: This later final decision supersedes the original FHIR-5716 cardinality while keeping the Patient association optional.

evidence_items.summary: The FHIR-54450 implementation changed BodyStructure.patient min from 1 to 0, and the combined branch already has a separate FHIR-54450 AutoFHIR audit commit.
evidence_items.learned: The optional cardinality is already applied and already represented, so FHIR-5716 should not duplicate or reverse it.

evidence_items.summary: OO minutes and related project notes record agreement that BodyStructure.patient should be 0..1 and that FHIR-54450 was applied.
evidence_items.learned: Work-group evidence corroborates the later cardinality relaxation used to interpret FHIR-5716 today.

evidence_items.summary: Resolved - No Change DSTU2 request to make BodySite.patient 0..1 because OO considered the redundancy intentional at that time.
evidence_items.learned: This is background showing optionality was previously rejected before the later FHIR-54450 applied reversal.
